topic: Bugatti Tourbillon: where a Cosworth 8.3L V16 revving to 9,000 RPM shares a chassis with a 650-component Swiss mechanical instrument cluster built by Concepto to watchmaking tolerances. Breguet's 1801 tourbillon invention, FAULHABER stepper motors, Divergent 3D-printed suspension, 1,800 hp hybrid system, and the engineering philosophy of mechanical permanence over digital obsolescence.
